title: Only Minuteman launched from a silo, at November 2
place_text: November 2 launch facility, Ellsworth missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: the only missile that ever flew out of the ground in the minute man program was at November 2 where I was located not during my time but in the 60s and I believe it flew for 5 seconds

plain: Only one missile ever flew out of the ground in the Minuteman program, the US land-based nuclear missile force, and it happened in the 1960s at a launch site called November 2 in South Dakota's Ellsworth missile field, where it flew for about five seconds. A former nuclear missile guard named Mario Woods says so. He was stationed at November 2 years later, so he passes it on as the history of his own post, not as something he saw.
